```{r}
# Load required libraries ------------------------------------
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
library(writexl)

# Load input data --------------------------------------------
# We use results_with_metadata2.csv
df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata2.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Check total number of vOTUs --------------------------------
length(unique(df$vOTUs))

# We build a vOTU-level infant dataset -----------------------
df_votu <- df %>%
  filter(
    mother_infant == "infant",
    bodysite == "stool"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    presence = if_else(CPM > 0, 1L, 0L),

    subject = factor(subject),
    vOTUs = factor(vOTUs),

    timepoint_months = as.numeric(timepoint_months),
    timepoint_scaled = as.numeric(scale(timepoint_months)),

    Contact_BF = factor(Contact_BF),
    feeding_cat = factor(feeding_cat),
    Exclusive_BF = factor(Exclusive_BF),
    Diet = factor(Diet),
    delivery = factor(delivery),
    intrapartum_ATB = factor(intrapartum_ATB)
  )

# We check number of infant stool vOTUs -------------------------
length(unique(df_votu$vOTUs))

# Count vOTU prevalence across samples -----------------------
votu_freq <- df_votu %>%
  group_by(vOTUs) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = sum(presence),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Keep non-rare vOTUs ----------------------------------------
votus_keep <- votu_freq %>%
  filter(n_samples >= 2) %>%
  pull(vOTUs)

# Filter dataset excluding rare vOTUs ------------------------
df_votu_nosing <- df_votu %>%
  filter(vOTUs %in% votus_keep)

# Check number of retained vOTUs -----------------------------
length(unique(df_votu_nosing$vOTUs))

# Fit diet model excluding rare vOTUs ------------------------
model_bin_diet_nosing <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * Diet +
    (1 | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu_nosing,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)

summary(model_bin_diet_nosing)

# Fit delivery model excluding rare vOTUs --------------------
model_bin_delivery_nosing <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * delivery +
    (1 | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu_nosing,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)

summary(model_bin_delivery_nosing)

# Fit feeding category model ---------------------------------
model_presence_feed <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * feeding_cat +
    (1 | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)

summary(model_presence_feed)

# Build abundance dataset by sample --------------------------
rich_df <- df_votu %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    subject,
    timepoint_months,
    feeding_cat
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_CPM = sum(CPM),
    richness = sum(presence),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_total_CPM = log10(total_CPM + 1),
    subject = factor(subject),
    feeding_cat = factor(feeding_cat),
    timepoint_scaled = as.numeric(scale(timepoint_months))
  )

# Fit feeding category abundance model -----------------------
model_abundance_feed <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * feeding_cat +
    (1 | subject),
  data = rich_df
)

summary(model_abundance_feed)
anova(model_abundance_feed)

# Fit feeding category model excluding rare vOTUs -------------
model_presence_feed_nosing <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * feeding_cat +
    (1 | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu_nosing,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)

summary(model_presence_feed_nosing)
```

```{r}
# We summarise sample sizes by feeding category ------------------
n_feeding_cat <- df_votu %>%
  select(
    subject,
    Sample,
    mother_infant,
    bodysite,
    timepoint_months,
    feeding_cat
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(feeding_cat)) %>%
  group_by(feeding_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_subjects = n_distinct(subject),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_subjects))

print(n_feeding_cat)

# Summarising sample sizes by feeding category and timepoint ----
n_feeding_cat_timepoint <- df_votu %>%
  select(
    subject,
    Sample,
    timepoint_months,
    feeding_cat
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(feeding_cat)) %>%
  group_by(timepoint_months, feeding_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_subjects = n_distinct(subject),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint_months, desc(n_subjects))

print(n_feeding_cat_timepoint)

# Summarise sample sizes by human milk exposure -------------
n_contact_bf <- df_votu %>%
  select(
    subject,
    Sample,
    Contact_BF
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Contact_BF)) %>%
  group_by(Contact_BF) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_subjects = n_distinct(subject),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_subjects))

print(n_contact_bf)

# Summarise sample sizes by human milk exposure (Contact_BF) and timepoint
n_contact_bf_timepoint <- df_votu %>%
  select(
    subject,
    Sample,
    timepoint_months,
    Contact_BF
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Contact_BF)) %>%
  group_by(timepoint_months, Contact_BF) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_subjects = n_distinct(subject),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint_months, desc(n_subjects))

print(n_contact_bf_timepoint)

# Summarise sample sizes by diet ------------------------------
n_diet <- df_votu %>%
  select(
    subject,
    Sample,
    Diet
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Diet)) %>%
  group_by(Diet) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_subjects = n_distinct(subject),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_subjects))

print(n_diet)

## MIXED MODELS FOR CPM ABUNDANCES 
# Build CPM abundance dataset --------------------------------
cpm_df <- df_votu %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    subject,
    timepoint_months,
    feeding_cat,
    Contact_BF,
    Diet,
    delivery,
    intrapartum_ATB
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_CPM = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    richness = sum(presence, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_total_CPM = log10(total_CPM + 1),
    subject = factor(subject),
    feeding_cat = factor(feeding_cat),
    Contact_BF = factor(Contact_BF),
    Diet = factor(Diet),
    delivery = factor(delivery),
    intrapartum_ATB = factor(intrapartum_ATB),
    timepoint_scaled = as.numeric(scale(timepoint_months))
  )

# Fit CPM model by feeding category --------------------------
model_cpm_feeding_cat <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * feeding_cat +
    (1 | subject),
  data = cpm_df
)

summary(model_cpm_feeding_cat)
anova(model_cpm_feeding_cat)

# Fit CPM model by human milk exposure ---------------------
model_cpm_contact_bf <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * Contact_BF +
    (1 | subject),
  data = cpm_df
)

summary(model_cpm_contact_bf)
anova(model_cpm_contact_bf)

# Fit CPM model by diet --------------------------------------
model_cpm_diet <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * Diet +
    (1 | subject),
  data = cpm_df
)

summary(model_cpm_diet)
anova(model_cpm_diet)

# Fit CPM model by delivery ----------------------------------
model_cpm_delivery <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * delivery +
    (1 | subject),
  data = cpm_df
)

summary(model_cpm_delivery)
anova(model_cpm_delivery)

# Fit CPM model by intrapartum antibiotics -------------------
model_cpm_atb <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * intrapartum_ATB +
    (1 | subject),
  data = cpm_df
)

summary(model_cpm_atb)
anova(model_cpm_atb)
```
